meta.name: ESP32-S31 Korvo Board voice HA controller
meta.description: Voice-controlled wall dashboard for a Home Assistant setup that controls the TRV radiator valves of each room

features.text: Voice control — wake word "Hi ESP", spoken commands in English (on-board ES8389 mic and speaker)
Room thermostat dashboard — on-board RGB LCD shows every room's TRV with its current temperature and setpoint
Touch control — GT1151 touch panel adjusts a room's target temperature
Home Assistant integration over MQTT with auto-discovery — the TRV controls appear as climate entities
Local web page — SoftAP + mDNS onboarding, Wi-Fi/settings page served by the device
Status LED (on-board WS2812 strip) — shows listening / thinking / speaking / offline
